episodes.synopsis: 6 Arthurs and their support fairies are sent on a mission into the past. In order to save the future, they must face and fight one million Arthurs.
episodes.title: Rebel into the Past

episodes.synopsis: Renkin is upset after being treated like a child, but a scholarly bookworm sees right through her. Will she be able to handle trouble all on her own?
episodes.title: The Forbidden Sacred Sword

episodes.synopsis: Tekken and Kakka infiltrate a mine to look for an Excalibur but it seems too good to be true. A little more digging reveals a troubling secret.
episodes.title: Fists of Fury

episodes.synopsis: Yamaneko visits a sacred land for fans of her favorite idol, but her hopes of saving the city are shot down by a vengeful vegetarian sniper.
episodes.title: With Love from the Sacred Land

episodes.synopsis: When Kakka is forced to cross-dress to sneak into an all-girls school, he has an unfortunate brush with the art club which reveals their twisted perversions.
episodes.title: A Rotten Art

episodes.synopsis: The girls are having some fun in the sun until a swimsuit thief starts running wild. Can they capture the culprit before everyone is fully exposed?
episodes.title: The Arthur Who Fished for Stars

episodes.synopsis: Rurou gets swept down a river and Bethor has declared him dead. Even when history changes for the better, the mission to destroy Excaliburs must go on.
episodes.title: Rosebud

episodes.synopsis: A trio of girls with magical powers fight to protect their city. To break their Excaliburs and correct history, the heroes must become the bad guys.
episodes.title: Call Us Magical Girls

episodes.synopsis: Tekken encounters an idol who is being chased by her fanatic fans. Luckily for her, Tekken feels obligated to help and becomes her temporary bodyguard.
episodes.title: Within the Beautiful Light

episodes.synopsis: When the odds are stacked against them, the group must decide to flee or fight. However, a lopsided battle ends up being the least of their worries.
episodes.title: Despair for the Future
